notes: Generated from repository context using IBM Bob IDE.
Some findings may require human validation.

repository.name: RepoLens Mobile Demo
repository.summary: Android application demonstrating repository intelligence visualization using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture and MVVM.

architecture.summary: The project separates UI, domain, and data responsibilities using feature modules and shared core modules.

layers.name: UI Layer
layers.responsibility: Renders screens, handles user actions, observes UI state from ViewModels.
risks: Some screens may contain business logic directly in composables.

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.responsibility: Contains use cases and business rules independent from Android framework.
risks: Some domain logic may be leaking into ViewModels.

layers.name: Data Layer
layers.responsibility: Handles network, database, cache, and repository implementations.
risks: Network and persistence mapping may be tightly coupled.

dataFlow.description: User events are sent from UI to ViewModel.
ViewModel delegates business logic to use cases.
Use cases access data through repository interfaces.
Repository implementation coordinates remote and local data sources.

architecture.dependencyDirection: UI -> Domain -> Data abstractions, Data implements Domain contracts
strengths: Clear separation between UI and data layers.
Repository pattern is used for data access.
ViewModels expose state to Compose UI.
concerns: Some modules may have direct dependencies on implementation details.
Missing tests around important state transitions.
recommendations: Move business logic from ViewModels to use cases.
Add tests for error and loading states.

modules.name: app
modules.responsibility: Application entry point, navigation setup, dependency wiring and app-level configuration.

risks.title: Navigation complexity may grow in app module
risks.whyItMatters: Centralized navigation can become difficult to maintain as features grow.
risks.recommendation: Move feature-specific navigation into feature modules where possible.
risks.suggestedTest: Add navigation route tests for core user flows.

modules.name: core-network
modules.responsibility: Provides network layer abstractions, Retrofit setup, and API clients.

modules.name: core-database
modules.responsibility: Provides Room database setup and DAOs for local persistence.

risks.title: Database migrations are not tested
risks.whyItMatters: Untested migrations can cause data loss in production.
risks.recommendation: Add migration tests for all schema changes.
risks.suggestedTest: Test migration from version 1 to 2 preserves user data.

modules.name: feature-home
modules.responsibility: Implements home screen feature with user dashboard and quick actions.

features.name: Home
features.description: Main landing experience for users after opening the app.
features.businessPurpose: Provides entry points to key product areas and displays user summary.
missingTests: Analytics event when card is clicked

risks.title: Error state may not preserve previous content
risks.whyItMatters: Users may see a blank screen after transient network errors.
risks.recommendation: Consider keeping stale content while showing a non-blocking error message.
risks.suggestedTest: When refresh fails after successful load, previous content remains visible.

suggestedPrChecklist: Check loading, content, empty and error states.
Add ViewModel tests for retry flow.

features.name: Profile
features.businessPurpose: Allows users to view and edit their profile information.

features.name: Settings
features.businessPurpose: Allows users to configure app behavior and preferences.

dependencyInjection.summary: Dependency injection is handled through Hilt modules and constructor injection.

modules.name: NetworkModule
risks: Too many network dependencies may be provided from one module.

modules.name: RepositoryModule
risks: Repository bindings should depend on abstractions to keep tests simple.

injectionPatterns: Constructor injection for ViewModels and use cases
Provides methods for Retrofit and database instances

risks.title: Some dependencies may have wider scope than needed
risks.whyItMatters: Overly broad scopes can make lifecycle and memory behavior harder to reason about.
risks.recommendation: Review whether all provided dependencies need Singleton scope.
risks.suggestedTest: Add tests with fake dependencies for ViewModels and use cases.

concurrency.summary: The project uses Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for asynchronous work and reactive state updates.

flows.name: homeUiState
flows.purpose: Exposes Home screen state to Compose UI.
risks: State updates should be atomic to avoid inconsistent UI states.

flows.name: profileUiState
flows.purpose: Exposes Profile screen state to Compose UI.

backgroundWork.name: SyncWorker
backgroundWork.purpose: Synchronizes cached data in the background.
risks: Retry policy should be validated for network failures.

sharedMutableState.name: inMemoryCache
sharedMutableState.risk: Potential race condition if accessed from multiple dispatchers without synchronization.

cancellationRisks: Long-running operations should check coroutine cancellation.
ViewModel jobs should be cancelled with viewModelScope.
recommendations: Add tests for cancellation and retry behavior.
Avoid shared mutable state or protect it with proper synchronization.

risks.title: Coroutine errors may not be handled consistently
risks.whyItMatters: Unhandled exceptions may cancel parent jobs or leave UI in loading state.
risks.recommendation: Wrap async calls with explicit error handling and expose error state.
risks.suggestedTest: Repository throws exception and ViewModel emits Error state.

uiLayer.summary: UI is implemented with Compose screens, reusable composables and ViewModel-driven state.

screens.name: HomeScreen
risks: Composable may grow too large if more states are added.
One-off events should not be represented as persistent UI state.
Route strings should be centralized or typed to avoid runtime mistakes.

recompositionRisks.title: Large composables may recompose more than necessary
recompositionRisks.recommendation: Split large composables and pass stable parameters.

concerns: Touch target sizes are not verified.
recommendations: Add content descriptions for important icons.

testing.summary: The project has partial unit test coverage, mostly around ViewModels and use cases.

suggestedTests: Repository returns domain error when API returns 500
ViewModel emits Error state when repository fails
Clicking home card emits NavigateToDetails side effect
Migration from v1 to v2 preserves data
Migration from v2 to v3 adds new columns

testabilityConcerns: Repository interfaces should be used in ViewModels.
Large composables may be hard to test.
recommendations: Add ViewModel tests for all UI states.
Add repository tests for network error mapping.
Add UI tests for critical flows.

risks.title: Important error flows are not covered by tests
risks.whyItMatters: Regression in error handling could result in stuck loading states or poor user experience.
risks.recommendation: Add ViewModel and repository tests for API failures, timeouts and empty responses.
risks.suggestedTest: When repository returns NetworkError, ViewModel emits Error state and hides loading.

risks.title: Database migrations are not tested
risks.whyItMatters: Untested migrations can cause data loss or app crashes in production.
risks.recommendation: Add migration tests for all schema versions.
risks.suggestedTest: Test migration from version 1 to 2 preserves all user data.

risks.title: Error states may not preserve previous content
risks.whyItMatters: Users may see blank screens after transient errors.
risks.recommendation: Keep stale content visible while showing error messages.
risks.suggestedTest: When refresh fails, previous content remains visible with error banner.

prReadiness.summary: The project is understandable and follows common Android architecture patterns, but several areas need stronger tests and clearer ownership.
readyItems: Architecture has clear UI, domain and data separation.
Main features can be identified from screens and ViewModels.
attentionItems: Error states need better test coverage.
Navigation routes should be made type-safe.
Coroutine exception handling should be checked.
prReadiness.suggestedPrDescription: This change improves repository understanding by introducing a structured RepoLens report generated by IBM Bob and visualized in an Android app. The app demonstrates clean architecture principles with proper separation of concerns.
qaChecklist: Verify all overview metrics are displayed correctly.
Open each module and feature detail screen.
Check empty and invalid JSON states.
Rotate device or test different screen sizes.
reviewerNotes: Validate whether Bob-generated file references are accurate.
Check that the app does not expose any private repository data.
Confirm JSON parsing is resilient to missing optional fields.
Review error handling for malformed JSON.
rollbackPlan: Remove generated JSON report from assets.
Keep schema and models for future iteration.

smartRecommendations.title: Add Unit Tests for ViewModels
smartRecommendations.description: Several ViewModels lack comprehensive unit tests. Adding tests will improve code quality and catch bugs early.
smartRecommendations.reasoning: ViewModels contain business logic that should be tested. Current test coverage is only 45% for ViewModels.

smartRecommendations.title: Implement Proper Error Handling
smartRecommendations.description: Network calls lack comprehensive error handling. Add retry logic and user-friendly error messages.
smartRecommendations.reasoning: Current implementation shows generic errors. Users need clear feedback when operations fail.

smartRecommendations.title: Optimize Large Files
smartRecommendations.description: HomeScreen.kt has 450 lines. Consider breaking it into smaller, reusable components.
smartRecommendations.reasoning: Large files are harder to maintain and test. Smaller components improve code organization.

smartRecommendations.title: Add Security Best Practices
smartRecommendations.description: Implement certificate pinning and encrypt sensitive data in local storage.
smartRecommendations.reasoning: Current implementation stores tokens in SharedPreferences without encryption.

smartRecommendations.title: Reduce Method Count
smartRecommendations.description: Current method count is 8542. Consider using R8/ProGuard optimization and removing unused dependencies.
smartRecommendations.reasoning: High method count can impact build times and app size. Optimization will improve performance.
